name: dev_command_contract
definition: canonical public command object used by legend, index, and dashboard display.

required.alias: string; canonical invocation token shown in human-facing views
required.name: string; terse no-space/no-dot command identifier
required.path_key: string; stable repo-path reference formatted as path#alias
required.ref: string; stable taxonomy-style reference formatted as scope/component/group/name

rules: commands are the invokable subset of discovered records
alias is required for human-facing command views
command names are terse identifiers, not formal labels
command aliases and names avoid dot notation
public command objects expose alias, name, path, path_key, ref, run, desc, and group
group must be one of sys, audit, or net
